title: Years at La Vida, Golden Dragon and the Pelican
summary: Handy dates his time at La Vida to about 1926-30 and says he organized a large orchestra for the Golden Dragon and the Pelican.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Oh, I left the La Vida somewhere around, uh, I was around, uh, I was around 27, I think. No. I was around, uh, I was around, uh, 29 to 30, I got La Vida. Because, uh, I got to La Vida to organize a band, and was playing at the, at that time they called it the Golden Dragon, but that was the, the story. Uh-huh. Uh-huh. Uh-huh. And then, there to the Pelican. Uh-huh.
Uh-huh. Uh-huh. How many years were you at the La Vida?
Uh-huh. I was actually at La Vida from, uh, around 26. Uh-huh. Until around 30. So, uh, then who did you have at the Pelican and the Golden Dragon?
Oh, I had a pretty large orchestra here, I told you yesterday.
The Louisiana Shakespeare. Yeah. Uh-huh. That bunch. I had that bunch together there then.
